ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This sited-based course will be held at the Morton Arboretum on Thursday evenings from 6:00 to 9:00 PM. There will also be two Saturday labs on March 21 and April 4 from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM and an all day field trip in the Chicago area (location TBA) on Monday April 13. Class will not meet on March 26. This section is for admitted degree seeking B.S. students in Horticulture.
